description: A C# application under central package management that ships an installer. The nuget manager cannot tell a runtime package from a test package, because every PackageVersion carries the same depType. A package in Directory.Packages.props is therefore a fix, and the repository names its test-only packages as chore.
The SDK in global.json is a fix, by the rule below. The MSBuild SDKs and the tools in dotnet-tools.json stay chore.

Lock file maintenance is a chore. Every NuGet version here is an exact central pin, and NuGet takes the lowest version a transitive range allows. A refresh therefore moves only the tooling lock files, which the installer never carries.
The WiX project is not in the nuget manager's default file list. managerFilePatterns is additive.

packageRules.description: SelfContained is true, so the installer carries the runtime of the SDK that builds it, and an SDK bump cuts a release.

A shorter name in a major bump's title, which the action's name pushes past 72 characters once the squash appends the pull request number. A grouped update takes its group name as its topic, so only a major reads this.
